svg.aria-label: A warp of eight lanes running a checker branch: the active mask after each of 17 instructions and the mask stack
svg.desc: A warp of eight lanes running a checker branch: the active mask after each of 17 instructions and the mask stack
svg.text: One warp, two sides of a branch
checker-branch.asm on a 4 x 2 block whose lanes
sit on dark (1) and light (0) squares, written
if: push the mask, keep the lanes where r5 is not 0
else: the saved mask minus the lanes that took the if
endif: pop, and the saved mask is back
masked off: waits, keeps its registers
stack entry, lanes 0 to 7: the mask saved by the if
... and, of those, the lanes that took the if
17 issues for the warp: both sides ran, each
on only the lanes that wanted it.
